note: Plan 096/09 — what the planted-shot occlusion check costs, and how often it actually finds the world in the way. Measured on `build/original/opensa` (pak of 2026-07-31, the vehicle-mods rebake) through tools-debug/bench-harness/drive.js at DPR 1, headless Chrome, this machine. Same protocol and the same caveats as the 096/08 row: these are `[video]` scene-protocol numbers, NOT a `[bench]` sweep, so do not compare them against the ingame/drive sweeps in this folder. READ BEFORE USING stepMs: `performance.now()` is coarsened to 0.1 ms in headless Chrome, so a single frame reads 0 or 0.1 and only the MEAN over thousands of frames is a measurement. WHAT THIS DOES NOT SHOW: blockedPlants is 0 in both runs, i.e. the ladder was never actually walked — three `flyby` plants across 14 scenes all found their authored spot clear. That bounds how COMMON planting into geometry is on these routes; it is not evidence that it cannot happen, which is exactly the assumption the phase exists to stop making. The mechanism itself is pinned by unit tests, not by these runs.

runs.what: seed 47 scenes 1-4, all drives (LA, VEGAS, SF, COUNTRYSIDE) — the same four scenes 096/08 measured, re-run with the plant check live.
seed 911 scenes 1-10 — a wider sample across every region, including the walk and flythrough kinds (which have no planted shots and so report castsMax 0).
